hero.label: Code · Daily · No Excuses
hero.subtitleLine1: One DSA problem a day. No copy-paste. No Googling.
hero.subtitleLine2: Hints cost stars — earn them back by solving clean.

dailyProblem.title: Get today's problem
dailyProblem.desc: One DSA problem every day. Difficulty matches your preference. Miss a day, and your streak resets.

solveScratch.title: Solve it from scratch
solveScratch.desc: The editor blocks paste in Hard mode. Type every character. That's where the learning is.

earnBadge.title: Earn your badge
earnBadge.desc: Clean solve with no hints earns stars. Stars unlock hints on harder days. A neat little brain loop.

tier1.title: Data Structure
tier1.desc: A nudge toward the right data structure.

tier2.title: Algorithm Name
tier2.desc: The pattern or algorithm that solves this.

footer.copyright: © 2026 GrinDev. Built for devs who want to get better.

today.trialRunNote: Trial run — does not count as submission
today.noProblemDesc: No problem is scheduled for today. Take a breath — you've earned it.
today.bonusDesc: Sorry for the gap — here's a bonus to keep you going!
today.bonusAlreadyGiven: You already received your bonus stars for today.
today.comeBackTomorrow: Come back tomorrow for a new problem.
today.pasteAllowed: Normal mode — paste allowed, fewer stars

rules.timer: Timer starts the moment you click Start — this includes reading time.
rules.noPaste: Paste is disabled in the code editor.
rules.stars: More stars for solving, but −2 stars if time runs out.
rules.locked: Mode cannot be changed after you start.

makeup.title: Make-Up Tasks
makeup.firstReward: First make-up solve today earns stars (minus the attempt cost). After that, additional make-ups only cost stars.
makeup.rewardGiven: You've already received your makeup star reward today. Additional make-ups cost stars with no reward.
makeup.noPastProblems: No missed problems. Come back tomorrow.

settings.title: Settings
settings.preferredDifficultyDesc: We'll assign you the closest available problem if your preferred level isn't scheduled.
settings.challengeModeDesc: Mode is locked once you start a problem. Resets each day.

difficultyNotes.any: You'll get a random problem each day.
difficultyNotes.specific: You'll get {difficulty} problems when available. If none are scheduled, you'll get the closest difficulty instead.

practiceMode.title: Practice Mode
practiceMode.desc: Choose what you practice each day. Changes take effect the next time you open Today.

dsa.label: DSA Problems
dsa.desc: Daily coding challenges. Solve in the code editor.

quiz.label: Knowledge Quiz
quiz.desc: Multiple-choice questions on JS, CSS, databases and more.

auth.noAccountNeeded: No account needed — sign in to start.

items.label: One problem per day
items.desc: A new DSA problem is scheduled every day. Solve it before midnight to keep your streak.

items.label: Preferred difficulty
items.desc: Set your preferred difficulty in Settings. We pick the closest available if your level isn't scheduled.

items.label: Already solved?
items.desc: Once you solve today's problem, you'll see the Make-Up Tasks section.

items.label: Keep it alive
items.desc: Solve at least one problem per day to maintain your streak. Miss a day and it resets to 0.

items.label: Streak counter
items.desc: Shown in the top-right corner. Your longest streak is tracked on your Profile page.

items.label: Earning stars
items.desc: Normal mode: +3 clean solve, +1 with hints. Hard mode: +8 clean, +3 with hints.

items.label: Spending stars
items.desc: Unlock hints (1–15 ⭐) and pay for Make-Up Tasks (5–25 ⭐ depending on how far back).

items.label: Bonus stars
items.desc: On days with no scheduled problem, you'll receive bonus stars as compensation.

items.label: Tier 1 — 1 ⭐
items.desc: A nudge toward the right data structure.

items.label: Tier 2 — 3 ⭐
items.desc: The name of the algorithm or pattern.

items.label: Tier 3 — 7 ⭐
items.desc: Step-by-step pseudocode.

items.label: Tier 4 — 15 ⭐
items.desc: Full working solution. Streak stays alive, but no clean solve badge.

items.label: Normal mode
items.desc: Paste is allowed. No timer. Fewer stars rewarded.

items.label: Hard mode
items.desc: Paste disabled. Timer counts down (Easy 15min, Medium 30min, Hard 45min). Higher rewards, but −2⭐ if time expires.

items.label: Mode lock
items.desc: Mode is locked once you start typing. Change it in Settings before beginning.

items.label: Catch up on missed days
items.desc: After solving today's problem, you can attempt problems from previous days you missed.

items.label: Star cost
items.desc: Make-ups cost stars: 5⭐ yesterday, up to 25⭐ for older days.

items.label: One reward per day
items.desc: Only the first make-up solve today earns stars. Additional make-ups only cost stars, no reward.

items.label: Write from scratch
items.desc: In Hard mode, paste is disabled — you must type your solution character by character.

items.label: Run Code
items.desc: Runs your code against hidden test cases. Results show expected vs your output on failure.

items.label: Reset
items.desc: Resets the editor back to the starter template. Requires confirmation.

streakFreeze.title: Streak Freeze
streakFreeze.desc: Protect your streak for one missed day. Your streak stays intact even if you skip a day.

problemSkip.title: Problem Skip
problemSkip.desc: Not feeling today's problem? Skip it and get a random problem from the full problem bank instead.

hintDiscount.title: Hint Discount
hintDiscount.desc: Reduce the cost of all hints by 1 star for one problem. Applied automatically on your next problem.

doubleStars.title: Double Stars
doubleStars.desc: Earn double stars on your next solved problem. Applies to the next submission only.

secondChance.title: Second Chance
secondChance.desc: Had a bad day? Reset your attempt count on a previously failed problem and try again cleanly.

streakFreeze.title: Buy Streak Freeze
streakFreeze.message: Spend {cost}⭐ for a streak freeze? It will activate automatically the next time you miss a day.

problemSkip.title: Skip Today's Problem
problemSkip.message: Spend {cost}⭐ to get a random problem instead of today's scheduled one?

messages.streakFreezePurchased: Streak freeze purchased! You now have {count} freeze(s).
messages.problemSkipped: Problem skipped! Check Today for your new problem.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.desc: More ways to earn and spend stars are coming — including star packs, subscriptions, and exclusive features.

ai.title: AI Explanation
ai.errorFallback: Could not load explanation. Please try again.
ai.hintTiersAvailable: Hint tiers still available below for step-by-step guidance.

timeLimits.title: Hard Mode Time Limits
timeLimits.desc: Seconds per difficulty in Hard Challenge Mode.

starRewards.title: Star Rewards
starRewards.desc: Stars awarded per solve type. Negative values deduct stars.

timeExpiredPenalty.title: Time expired penalty (Hard Mode)
timeExpiredPenalty.desc: Stars deducted when Hard Mode timer runs out

aiFeatures.title: AI Features
aiFeatures.desc: Star cost charged to users for AI-powered features. Stars are refunded if the request fails.

explain.label: AI Problem Explanation
explain.desc: Explain what a DSA problem is asking and hint at the approach

codeReview.label: AI Code Review
codeReview.desc: Review submitted code for correctness, complexity, and style

quizRewards.title: Quiz Star Rewards
quizRewards.desc: Stars awarded based on quiz score percentage.
